svg.title: Sharding in Modern Databases v2
svg.desc: Visual summary of how NoSQL and SQL databases handle sharding, with testable sub-details
svg.text: Most managed — you just pick a key

g.text: Hashed key → ranges over hash space
"Use DynamoDB with user_id as partition key"
or "Shard with Vitess on user_id, plan for operator-driven online resharding"
You specify the shard / partition key — the DB handles the rest

svg.text: Mechanics differ; developer abstraction level is the same
